_comment: vendor-vuln-unknown says one thing to either submission - the VENDOR entry is already there, and its SOURCE is what has to change - so its two responses differ only in the page they send the developer to. This fixture is what pins that: the same finding as its XPI twin, reported in a source code review, carrying the source-code-submission link instead of the vendoring guide. The XPI here also ships a VENDORS.md of its own, which in a source-code submission belongs in the archive - the copy the reviewer reads and the build installs from - so sca-not-required warns that this did not need to be a source submission. It is advice about the NEXT one and narrows nothing here.
